description: Gold cases for Phase 1A entity resolution, cross-type edge survival, chunk mention tagging and chunker equation detection. Expectations encode the intended policy, not current behavior.
policy_notes: Parameter-scale suffixes (7B, 70B, 8B) identify a checkpoint of the same model family and should merge into the family node.
Version, generation, precision bit-width and routing k-value tokens identify distinct entities and must never merge.
A bare name with no version merges only with its explicit v1 form (FlashAttention == FlashAttention-1).
Entity identity is (entity_type, name): a Paper and the ModelFamily it introduces are different nodes.
